itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.source: Meals: Dinner, depending on arrival time Overnight: Cairo

itinerary.title: Old Cairo, the Citadel and Islamic Cairo
itinerary.source: After breakfast, a gentle but substantial first day in the city.

itinerary.title: Grand Egyptian Museum and Pyramids of Giza
itinerary.source: Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner Overnight: Cairo

itinerary.title: Fly to the Red Sea
itinerary.source: Meals: Breakfast and dinner, per the resort's all-inclusive plan Overnight: Hurghada

itinerary.title: Hurghada: Recovery by the Red Sea
itinerary.source: Meals: All meals, per the resort's all-inclusive plan Overnight: Hurghada

itinerary.title: Drive to Luxor and Board the Nile Cruise
itinerary.source: On arrival, board the Nile cruise, home for the next four nights.

itinerary.title: Luxor
itinerary.source: Return to the ship for lunch, dinner, and the night on board.

itinerary.title: Edfu, Kom Ombo and the Sail South
itinerary.source: The ship sails south toward Aswan, and the day follows the river.

itinerary.title: Abu Simbel by Air, and Aswan
itinerary.source: Return to the ship for the final night on board.

itinerary.title: Cairo: The Oldest Pyramids and a Farewell
itinerary.source: After breakfast and disembarkation, the group transfers to Aswan Airport for the flight back to Cairo, and then drives south of the city to where pyramid-building began.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.source: After breakfast and check-out, transfer to Cairo International Airport for the onward flight.
